text:
What's A Toy To Wear?!
Toy Story 5 filmmakers break down the "Shed Toys" scene in which Jessie meets some toys that have definitely not been forgotten! Directors Andrew Stanton, Kenna Harris, and Producer Lindsey Collins give an exclusive behind the scenes look at storyboards, clips, concept art, and more from TOY STORY 5, full episode out now & the movie is now streaming on Disney+!
